title: Lasagna Zucchini Boats
description: Tender zucchini halves stuffed with seasoned ground beef and rich marinara, layered with creamy herbed ricotta, and baked under melted mozzarella and parmesan cheese.

ingredients.item: chopped fresh parsley, plus more for garnish
lean ground beef or ground turkey
salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
chopped fresh basil, plus more for garnish

instructions: Scoop out the centers of each halved zucchini with a spoon, leaving a 1/4-inch rim around the edges to form sturdy boats.
In a mixing bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, egg, chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper. Stir in 1/2 cup of the mozzarella and all of the parmesan cheese until thoroughly blended.

Heat 2 tsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef, season with salt and pepper, and cook while crumbling until browned and cooked through, then drain any excess fat.
Stir the marinara sauce and chopped basil into the skillet with the beef, then remove from heat.
Lightly brush both sides of the zucchini boats with the remaining 2 tsp of olive oil and place them in baking dishes. Divide the ricotta mixture evenly among the boats, spreading it smooth.
Spoon the meat and marinara sauce over the ricotta filling in each boat. Cover the baking dishes with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove foil, sprinkle the remaining 3/4 cup mozzarella over the tops, and bake uncovered for 5 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Garnish with fresh basil and parsley, and serve warm.
